rationale: The non-authorizing eventual delivery-path candidate is structured_delivery because the supplied evidence indicates new product semantics across three canonical owners and three source paths. Compact delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied; verified_change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Canonical owner count is 3 and source path count is 3, indicating cross-owner scope.
Four derived paths exist while deterministic propagation is false.
Compact delivery prerequisites are incomplete: no completed Brownfield analysis and no stored quick_task context are in/
Verified change prerequisites fail: canonical_owner_count is not exactly 1 and deterministic propagation is absent.
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
This is a benchmark candidate only and does not constitute a Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
